title: Am Dienstag gewaschen
desc: You used the machine on somebody else’s day
setting: The laundry room, two hours later, with your washing still in the machine.

steps.speaker: Frau Steiner
steps.es: Entschuldigung. Der Dienstag ist mein Tag.
steps.en: Excuse me. Tuesday is my day.

options.feedback: She is right, and saying so ends it. Nobody here wants an argument, they want the rota kept.

options.es: Die Maschine ist leer. Ich dachte, es geht.
options.en: The machine was empty. I thought it was fine.
options.feedback: A reason, which she will accept and not agree with. Empty is not the same as free.

options.en: But nobody is using it right now.
options.feedback: That is the argument, and it is the one that makes an enemy in a building you will live in for years.

steps.speaker: Frau Steiner
steps.es: Sie müssen sich in den Plan eintragen. Dann gehört der Tag Ihnen.
steps.en: You have to sign into the rota. Then the day is yours.

options.es: Ich trage mich das nächste Mal ein.
options.en: I will sign myself in next time.
options.feedback: Uses her own verb back. eintragen is the word the whole system runs on.
On the wall by the door. Asking is better than guessing again.
Yes, and it is in the Hausordnung, which she knows and now knows you have not read.

steps.speaker: Frau Steiner
steps.es: Nehmen Sie Ihre Wäsche heraus. Ich brauche die Maschine jetzt.
steps.en: Take your washing out. I need the machine now.

options.feedback: Immediate and one more apology. That closes it properly.
The Tumbler is Tuesday’s too. You are asking for the second half of the day you already took.
Reasonable, and she has been waiting two hours already.

steps.speaker: Frau Amrein
steps.es: Und? War die Frau Steiner böse?

options.feedback: The right answer, and she will report it to the building exactly as you said it.
Honest. She will tell you Frau Steiner is never cross, which is nearly true.

options.en: How do you know about it already?
options.feedback: She always knows already. Asking her that is a joke she will enjoy.
